title: SEC3: FIPS probe applied to throwaway fd
description: wc_crypto2dev_init() opens a separate fips_probe_fd, issues CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS on it, then immediately closes it. If REQUIRE_FIPS is per-fd kernel state (not process-global), the pool fds and g_crypto2dev_fd opened afterward do not have FIPS enforcement. The REQUIRE_FIPS ioctl must be issued on g_crypto2dev_fd and on each pool fd, not on a throwaway fd. If REQUIRE_FIPS is process-global, this works but should be documented. Either way the current code has no documentation of which semantic is assumed.
